name: deicod/wp-connectors
description: WordPress 7.0 AI connector plugins (z.ai, Codex, Grok, Claude Pro) for the native Settings -> Connectors screen.

scripts-descriptions.check: Full offline validation entry point: syntax lint, PHPCS (WordPress + PHP 7.4 compatibility), static analysis, convention enforcement, and the PHPUnit suite. Never contacts the network.
scripts-descriptions.lint: PHP syntax check (php -l) over all repository PHP sources, excluding vendor/tools/dist.
scripts-descriptions.conventions: Enforce docs/CONVENTIONS.md over every plugin directory (headers, text domain, version constant, autoloader, self-containment).
scripts-descriptions.scan-secrets: Scan repository sources for live-credential patterns (fixture-marked lines allowed).
scripts-descriptions.phpcs: PHP_CodeSniffer with the WordPress coding standard.
scripts-descriptions.phpcs-compat: PHPCompatibility scan pinned to the supported PHP range (7.4-8.4).
scripts-descriptions.test: PHPUnit test suite (offline; outbound HTTP is blocked unless explicitly mocked).
